description: Two independent full-stack implementation assignments and two maintenance assignments, frozen after the post-040 scratch-control checkpoint and before stack scaffolds, reference implementations, protocol thresholds, or measured agent output.

common_contract.server: Expose the exact GET status route and typed POST JSON route declared by the task. Reject malformed JSON, missing fields, unknown fields, wrong field types, and out-of-domain numeric values. A number is a JSON integer and never a boolean; yesno is a JSON boolean.
common_contract.errors: Return status 400 with {"error":"invalid_json"} for invalid JSON shape, types, or values. Return status 415 with {"error":"json_content_type_required"} for a POST body without application/json. Return status 413 with {"error":"body_too_large"} when the request body exceeds the frozen limit.
common_contract.browser: Expose the declared deterministic scalar browser function as an ES module export and return the exact frozen values in real Chromium.
common_contract.cross_target: The response field named by shared_result_field must equal the browser export for equivalent inputs.
common_contract.network: Bind only to 127.0.0.1 on the harness-selected port.
common_contract.numeric_domain: All numeric inputs are nonnegative integers.

tasks.title: Build an observatory schedule across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Observatory Schedule contract in the supplied stack. session_total is public_talks + research_tracks. open_minutes is public_talks * 22 + research_tracks * 31. weather_minutes is dome_sections * 7 during cloud_monitoring and zero otherwise. scheduled_minutes is open_minutes + weather_minutes. staff_minutes is scheduled_minutes * dome_sections. rest_breaks is scheduled_minutes divided by 90 using floor division. coordination_score is staff_minutes + rest_breaks * 13 + session_total * 5. observatory_mode is research_first when research_tracks is greater than public_talks, outreach when any public talks remain, and standby otherwise. The browser export returns coordination_score.
tasks.independence: New observatory scheduling domain, v5 route, floor-break and staff-load formulas, vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected after the scratch-control checkpoint and before any 041 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Build a reef nursery flow planner across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Reef Nursery contract in the supplied stack. nursery_trays is coral_trays + algae_trays. base_flow_liters is coral_trays * 12 + algae_trays * 7. night_flush_liters is circulation_pumps * 5 during a night_cycle and zero otherwise. required_flow_liters is base_flow_liters + night_flush_liters. pump_capacity_liters is circulation_pumps * 20. served_flow_liters is min(required_flow_liters, pump_capacity_liters). overflow_flow_liters is max(required_flow_liters - pump_capacity_liters, 0). reef_index is served_flow_liters + overflow_flow_liters * 9 + coral_trays * 3. nursery_state is balanced when overflow_flow_liters is zero, night_overflow when overflow remains during a night cycle, and daytime_overflow otherwise. The browser export returns reef_index.
tasks.independence: New reef-nursery domain, v5 route, flow/capacity formulas, vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected before any 041 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Repair storm-adjusted mountain shelter warming
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Rescue Shelter application. hiker_total is arriving_hikers + injured_hikers. baseline_warmth is arriving_hikers * 3 + injured_hikers * 6. lockdown_reduction is heater_packs * 2 during storm_lockdown and zero otherwise. required_warmth is max(baseline_warmth - lockdown_reduction, 0). pack_capacity is heater_packs * 8. delivered_warmth is min(required_warmth, pack_capacity). uncovered_warmth is max(required_warmth - delivered_warmth, 0). unused_capacity is max(pack_capacity - delivered_warmth, 0). shelter_state is covered when uncovered_warmth is zero, storm_gap when uncovered warmth remains during storm lockdown, and supply_gap otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns unused_capacity.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module chooses delivered_warmth from baseline_warmth before applying lockdown_reduction, so storm requests can over-deliver and understate unused capacity.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The lockdown mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.

tasks.title: Repair winter rationing for rehabilitation birds
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Aviary Feeding application. bird_total is resident_birds + rehab_birds. resident_scoops is resident_birds * 2. rehab_scoops is rehab_birds * 3. winter_scoops is bird_total during winter_ration and zero otherwise. required_scoops is resident_scoops + rehab_scoops + winter_scoops. available_scoops is feed_bins * 10. served_scoops is min(required_scoops, available_scoops). shortage_scoops is max(required_scoops - available_scoops, 0). feed_state is stocked when shortage_scoops is zero, winter_shortage when shortage remains during winter rationing, and shortage otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns required_scoops.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module computes winter_scoops from resident_birds only, omitting the additional ration owed to rehabilitation birds.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The winter-ration mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.
